title: Kalev wakes from a strange dream

approval.notes: Opening monologue for the Maker's Mark prologue. Kalev wakes near his bed and recalls a bizarre dream. The stew joke is an ambient bark from the room, not part of the blocking monologue.

deterministic_offline.notes: Linear blocking monologue; the nearby NPC comment is authored separately as a non-blocking bark.

nodes.text: Ugh... what a dream. What a... mad dream.
It was as if I was in the future - roads made of metal, men flying in metal birds, and we were ruling the Germans and the Russians. Can you imagine? Us! Ruling over them. Ha.

source_notes.summary: Kalev wakes from a prophetic dream about the future - a meta nod to Estonia's modern history of occupation and independence. The room's comic interruption belongs to the bark layer.
